name: Delta Electronics (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Delta Electronics (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, researches and develops, manufactures, and distributes electronic products. The company operates through four segments: Power Electronics, Mobility, Infrastructure, and Automation.
